appearance: Day; wet qualifying/race followed by later dry overcast shots.
layout: Gilles-Villeneuve Grand Prix circuit, 14 corners; island road course.
sector_registration: All stations in retained native origin. Approximate full-route zones; individual decor must stay beyond verified protection and runoff.

sectors.name: Pits and Senna S
sectors.observed_environment: Long gray glazed paddock/garage bar opposite covered stands. Senna S backed by open metal bleachers and flags. Close walls, short grass, red/white kerbs.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: T3/T4 to T6/T7
sectors.observed_environment: Tight tree-lined chicane corridor; concrete panels and tall catch fencing close to asphalt. Mature deciduous canopy, service access gaps and occasional bridge structures.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: Island middle straight and T8/T9
sectors.observed_environment: Flat island woodland, catch fence, short verges, overhead bridge/catwalk. Long forest views; do not line this stretch with city towers.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: Hairpin stadium
sectors.observed_environment: Tight hairpin with grass on inside and large open unroofed metal grandstands surrounding the outside. Gray stair aisles and flagpoles; small flat-roof race-service tower.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: Casino straight
sectors.observed_environment: Long fenced tree avenue and steel bridge crossing; Montreal casino asymmetric white structural silhouette appears beyond park, not an arbitrary tower wall. Narrow grass shoulders with wall protection.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: Final chicane and pit return
sectors.observed_environment: Close final chicane wall, red/white apex kerb, green/blue wall panels and forest behind. Kerb and exit walls must follow the linked left-right geometry.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.
